chapter: Chicago, Detroit and Seattle Harmony Kings
title: The Epstein brothers refuse to let him leave
summary: The Purple Gang boss claims the contract, then phones Niebaur and makes him come to Detroit instead.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: Ruth Fowler--

Ruth Fowler--- yes - and I was crazy about her - wanted to marry her and all this stuff--- and, uh, so and we sort of talked it over because that boss liked us - he liked both Joe and me - and he used to buy us drinks where he never bought anybody else in the band any drinks and he used to say to me -- okay, kid, get your coat and girl and we're going out and it might be five minutes before the show and I'd say - well, I have play -- he said, oh, forget it - they'll get along without you -- and, he'd take us out on the town, you know. So, Joe and I talked it over - which one of us is going to tell him we're leaving -- so, I did - I got elected for this job. So, one night after the job I went to the boss' office and I said -- his name was something Stein anyway---
I think it was Epstein---
Epstein - yeah - that's right -- he was almost---
Jacob or Joseph---
Joseph - well, there was two of them anyway --
Two brothers - Jacob and Joseph Epstein - wasn't it?
Yeah -- yeah - they sort of run the Purple Gang really.
Yeah.

And, so, I went there and I told him and he let me tell the whole story. And, he just sat there and looked at me and I said, well - that's it Mr.-- And, he said -- "well, that's not it at all". He said, "You're not leaving here." And, I said -- "What -- what do you mean?" He said -- "You're staying right here until I want you to leave." He said, "You signed a contract here." And, I thought - in my mind I thought - boy, some free country-- So, he could see my face drop clear down to the floor -- you know because my heart was set on---
You weren't breaking the contract though because the contract was up just - you wouldn't have been breaking it by leaving it---
Well, it was up a short time from there, but the point is -- he said - just stand right here---
He just didn't want you to go --

No - so, when I was going out the door - he said, hey, kid - come back here - I want to ask you something -- he said, do you know where you can get this fellow on the phone -- and I said - you mean, Niebaur yes, I said - he is going to be Castle Farm; he should be
there now with the band -- so, he said - get him on the phone. So, I got him on the phone. He said - let me talk to him. So I..."Eddie? Wild Bill or Bill DAVISON---"
Yeah - you weren't Wild Bill yet--
And, he said - I'll talk to him--- he didn't let me talk to him at all. He got on the phone -- he said -- are you this fellow who wants to hire Davison and Hoover--
Hooven--

Hooven -- and he said, I suppose he said - yes. He said, well, if you want these fellows to join you, it's going to be an impossibility -- but, if you want to join him here, that's all right too. So, now, they did something on the phone and I suppose Eddie was in a spot where he didn't have a job after the Castle Farm at that moment so he took it and they joined us there.
In Detroit.
